title: Which Study Design Answers Which Question? A Decision Map

hook.en: Many research problems start with the wrong tool. A survey cannot prove a treatment works, and a trial cannot tell you how patients feel. Match the question to the design first, and half the battle is won.
hook.ur: Bohat se research masail ghalat aale se shuru hote hain. Survey sabit nahi kar sakta ke ilaaj kaam karta hai, aur trial nahi bata sakta ke mareez kaisa mehsoos karte hain. Pehle sawal ko design se milayein, aadhi jang jeet li.

goal.en: By the end, you'll choose a sensible design for a therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, risk, frequency or experience question, and say why a wrong design cannot answer a question however large it is.
goal.ur: End tak aap therapy, diagnosis, prognosis, risk, frequency ya tajurbe ke sawal ke liye munasib design chunenge, aur batayenge ke ghalat design kisi sawal ka jawab nahi de sakta chahe kitna bhi bara ho.

text.en: The question decides the design. **"Does it work?"** needs a comparison with random allocation. **"How common is it?"** needs a representative survey. **"What happens to people with it?"** needs a cohort followed over time. **"Is the test accurate?"** needs a test compared with a reference standard. **"What is it like to live with?"** needs people's own words. A big study with the wrong design only gives a very precise wrong answer.
text.ur: Sawal design tay karta hai. **"Kya kaam karta hai?"** ko random allocation ke saath muqabla chahiye. **"Kitna aam hai?"** ko numaindah survey chahiye. **"Is bimari wale logon ka kya hota hai?"** ko waqt ke saath follow hone wala cohort chahiye. **"Kya test durust hai?"** ko reference standard se milaya gaya test chahiye. **"Is ke saath jeena kaisa hai?"** ko logon ke apne alfaaz chahiye. Bara study ghalat design ke saath sirf bohat durust ghalat jawab deta hai.

text.en: Think of **tools in a toolbox**. A hammer is brilliant for nails and useless for screws. A thermometer cannot measure a distance, however expensive it is. Each design is a tool built for one kind of job. The craft is knowing which one to pick.
text.ur: **Toolbox ke aale** sochein. Hathoda keelon ke liye shandar aur screws ke liye bekaar hai. Thermometer fasla nahi naap sakta, chahe kitna mehnga ho. Har design ek qism ke kaam ke liye bana aala hai. Hunar yeh jaanna hai ke kaun sa chunein.

title.en: Match the question to the design

rows.en: Does a home exercise programme reduce knee pain more than advice?
rows.ur: Kya ghar ki exercise programme advice se zyada ghutne ka dard kam karti hai?

rows.en: What percentage of office workers in Lahore have neck pain today?
rows.ur: Lahore ke daftari karkunon mein kitne fisad ko aaj gardan dard hai?

rows.en: How many people with a first ankle sprain still have symptoms at six months?
rows.ur: Pehli takhne ki moch wale kitne log chhe mahine baad bhi alamaat rakhte hain?
Kya wajah ya khatra barhata hai?

rows.en: Is heavy lifting linked to later low back pain?
rows.ur: Kya bhaari uthana baad ke low back pain se juda hai?

rows.en: How well does the Lachman test detect ACL rupture compared with MRI?
rows.ur: Lachman test MRI ke muqabale ACL tootne ko kitni achhi tarah pakadta hai?

rows.en: What is it like for patients?
How do stroke survivors experience returning home?
rows.ur: Stroke se bachne wale ghar wapsi ko kaisa mehsoos karte hain?

title.en: Pick a design in four questions

steps.title: What do I want to know?
steps.detail: Effect, frequency, course, cause, accuracy or experience: name it in one word. || Mujhe kya jaanna hai?

steps.title: Do I need to give an intervention?
steps.detail: If I want to know whether something works, I usually must compare people who get it and people who do not, ideally by random allocation. || Kya mujhe intervention dena hai?

steps.title: Can I ethically and practically do that?
steps.detail: If a trial is unethical or impossible, such as exposing people to harm, use a cohort or case-control study. || Kya main akhlaqi aur amali taur par yeh kar sakta hoon?

steps.title: What can I afford in time and people?
steps.detail: A small, well-designed study often beats a large, poorly designed one; if a study is not feasible, start with a pilot or audit. || Waqt aur logon ke lihaz se main kya afford kar sakta hoon?

question.en: A student wants to know whether neck exercises reduce headache frequency in office workers. Which design should she choose?
question.ur: Ek talibah jaanna chahti hai ke gardan ki exercises daftari karkunon mein sar dard ki frequency kam karti hain ya nahi. Use kaun sa design chunna chahiye?

text.en: A single case report on one worker
text.ur: Ek karkun par ek case report

feedback.en: One case cannot show an effect.
feedback.ur: Ek case asar nahi dikha sakta.

text.en: A survey asking workers whether they think exercise helps
text.ur: Survey jo karkunon se poochhe kya woh samajhte hain exercise madad karti hai

feedback.ur: Yeh raaye record karta hai, asar nahi.

text.en: A randomised controlled trial comparing exercise with a control
text.ur: Randomised controlled trial jo exercise ka control se muqabla kare

feedback.en: Yes — a question about effect needs a fair comparison.
feedback.ur: Haan — asar ke sawal ko munsifana muqabla chahiye.

question.en: A clinic wants to know what proportion of its diabetic patients have foot numbness today. What design is best?
question.ur: Ek clinic jaanna chahta hai ke us ke sugar ke kitne mareez aaj paon ka sunnpan rakhte hain. Kaun sa design behtar hai?

text.en: A randomised trial of a new foot exercise
text.ur: Naye paon ki exercise ka randomised trial

feedback.en: A trial answers a treatment question.
feedback.ur: Trial ilaaj ke sawal ka jawab deta hai.

feedback.en: It would describe experiences, not give a proportion.
feedback.ur: Yeh tajurbe bayan karta, proportion nahi deta.

text.en: A cross-sectional survey or audit of current patients
text.ur: Mojooda mareezon ka cross-sectional survey ya audit

feedback.en: Yes — a snapshot of frequency at one time needs a cross-sectional design.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek waqt par frequency ka snapshot cross-sectional design chahta hai.

question.en: Why can a very large survey not prove that a treatment works?
question.ur: Bohat bara survey sabit kyun nahi kar sakta ke ilaaj kaam karta hai?

text.en: Because surveys are not allowed to ask about treatment
text.ur: Kyunke surveys ko ilaaj ke baare mein poochhne ki ijazat nahi

feedback.en: They can ask; they just cannot show cause.
feedback.ur: Woh poochh sakte hain; bas wajah nahi dikha sakte.

text.en: Without a comparison group and allocation, it cannot separate the treatment from other explanations, however large it is
text.ur: Comparison group aur allocation ke baghair yeh ilaaj ko doosri wazahaton se alag nahi kar sakta, chahe kitna bhi bara ho

feedback.en: Yes — size gives precision, not a fair comparison.
feedback.ur: Haan — size durusti deta hai, munsifana muqabla nahi.

text.en: Because large numbers always cause bias
text.ur: Kyunke bade numbers hamesha bias paida karte hain

feedback.en: Large numbers do not by themselves cause bias.
feedback.ur: Bade numbers khud bias paida nahi karte.

text.en: **Starting with the method and then finding a question.** "I will do a survey" is not a plan. Start with the question, name its type, and then choose the design. Also avoid asking one study to do too many jobs, such as proving the effect, describing experience and measuring cost all at once; pick one primary question.
text.ur: **Pehle tareeqa chun kar phir sawal dhoondna.** "Main survey karunga" plan nahi. Sawal se shuru karein, uski qism batayein, phir design chunein. Ek study se bohat se kaam lene se bhi bachein, jaise asar sabit karna, tajurba bayan karna aur kharch naapna ek saath; ek primary sawal chunein.

text.en: **Ask what decision the study will help with.** A therapist wondering whether a new cold-pack routine is worth buying needs a comparison, not a survey of how much patients like it. Linking the design to the decision stops a clinic from collecting data that cannot answer what it needs to know.
text.ur: **Poochhein study kaun se faisle mein madad karega.** Jo therapist soch raha hai ke nayi cold-pack routine khareedna theek hai ya nahi, usay muqabla chahiye, yeh survey nahi ke mareez kitna pasand karte hain. Design ko faisle se jorna clinic ko aisa data jama karne se rokta hai jo ahem sawal ka jawab na de.

question.en: Can one study answer two types of question at once?
question.ur: Kya ek study do qism ke sawalon ka jawab de sakti hai?

answer.en: Yes, when designed for it. A trial can include a nested qualitative study (to learn why it worked or did not) and a cost analysis. These mixed designs are powerful, but each part must still be planned to answer its own question. Do not simply add extra questions to a study built for another purpose.
answer.ur: Haan, jab is ke liye design ho. Trial mein ek andar bana qualitative study (yeh jaanne ke liye ke kyun kaam kiya ya nahi) aur kharch ka tajziya shamil ho sakta hai. Yeh mila-jula designs taqatwar hain, lekin har hissay ko apne sawal ke liye plan karna hoga. Kisi aur maqsad ke liye bane study mein bas mazeed sawal na jorein.

beats.patient: A therapist wants to know whether a new balance programme reduces falls in older adults. She sends a questionnaire to the clients who finished the programme and finds that 90 percent say it was helpful.
beats.assessment: She has asked a therapy question with a satisfaction survey of survivors, so she has no comparison group and no data on those who dropped out.
beats.treatment: A better design would randomly allocate participants to the programme or usual care and count falls over a year for both groups.
beats.reassess: A comparison shows the true effect; a satisfaction survey can still be useful as a secondary measure.

text.en: **Design must not put participants at risk.** If a design would withhold a known effective treatment or expose people to harm, an ethics committee will not allow it. In such cases use observational designs or a comparison with usual care, never with an unsafe placebo.
text.ur: **Design se mareez khatre mein na parein.** Agar design maloom mu'assir ilaaj rok de ya logon ko nuqsan se do-chaar kare to ethics committee ijazat nahi dega. Aise mein observational designs ya usual care se muqabla istemal karein, ghair mehfooz placebo se kabhi nahi.

text.en: Sackett and Wennberg argued that the best research design depends on the question: for example, randomised trials for efficacy questions, cohort studies for prognosis and harm questions, and diagnostic test studies for accuracy questions. Grimes and Schulz described the lay of the land in clinical research, from descriptive studies to analytic ones, and stressed that each design has strengths and weaknesses that suit particular questions.
text.ur: Sackett aur Wennberg ne daleel di ke behtareen research design sawal par munhasir hai: masalan efficacy ke sawalon ke liye randomised trials, prognosis aur nuqsan ke sawalon ke liye cohort studies, aur durusti ke sawalon ke liye diagnostic test studies. Grimes aur Schulz ne clinical research ki tasveer descriptive se analytic studies tak bayan ki, aur zor diya ke har design ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan hain jo khaas sawalon ke munasib hain.

text.en: **Question first, Design second.** Name the question type, then choose the tool.
text.ur: **Pehle sawal, Phir design.** Sawal ki qism batayein, phir aala chunein.

summary.en: The question decides the design: effect needs comparison, frequency needs a survey, course needs a cohort, accuracy needs a diagnostic study, experience needs qualitative research.
summary.ur: Sawal design tay karta hai: asar ko muqabla, frequency ko survey, raaste ko cohort, durusti ko diagnostic study, tajurbe ko qualitative research chahiye.

summary.en: A large study with the wrong design gives a precise but wrong answer.
summary.ur: Ghalat design wala bara study durust lekin ghalat jawab deta hai.

summary.en: Choose the design the question needs, within ethics and what you can realistically do.
summary.ur: Woh design chunein jo sawal chahta hai, akhlaqiyat aur amali imkaan ke andar.

front.ur: "Kaisa lagta hai" ka jawab kaun sa design deta hai?

note.ur: Har design kahan hai aur kahan gumrah karta hai.
